payload_per_tested_eight_layer_map.scope: Cold construction of both HD arrays. Same final RGBA8 GPU payload; no per-frame/FPS or physical-device claim.

final_change: Preserve per-layer CPU processing before collecting outputs for Compatibility, headless, HD-off and single-layer maps. Resident compute/pixel math unchanged.

excluded_attempts.reason: One fixture-lifetime failure: check loop retained array references until function return. All 87 byte outputs matched. Moved loop to helper; final accepted lifetime cases pass.

limitations: Only Linux desktop GPU runs. No Android/web/Windows/macOS or whole-game performance/peak-memory claim.
Fallbacks retain existing Image processing. Pinned TextureLayeredRD and TextureStorage reject single-layer RD arrays.
TerrainColorCache currently reads terrain arrays only on Compatibility; future Vulkan CPU consumers must account for readback.
Initial bz2g/bz4g/bz13h water-focused points can be buried. Additional zone1 visible-water fixtures prove water coverage and toggle response.
Same pre-existing engine worker-pool shutdown issue as P2 scenery: fixtures release textures and drain frames before exit. This does not fix the engine issue.
Foreground setup timings are not asynchronous GPU completion or controlled load-time results.
No direct compressed terrain-array or HD-memory-policy change.
